class.name: AudioBusSettingsRows
class.brief_description: The settings file of [AudioBusSettingsServer]: one row per bus.
class.description: The storage form of an [AudioBusListSettings]: what [AudioBusSettingsServer] writes to its settings file and reads back from it. It holds nothing but the list, so the file can also be a CSV file with one line per bus. Games do not need this class: use [AudioBusSettingsServer] and [AudioBusListSettings].

members.member: The rows, one per bus, identified by [member AudioBusSettingsRow.bus_name].
